Alex — thanks for the clear list.

I put together a compact package and proposed a walkthrough slot (details below). Attached in this email:
- RDW-network-thermograph-v1.pdf — high-level annotated schematic comparing Dedicated vs Private deployments, callouts for control plane location and egress paths.

- SOC2-control-crosswalk-Helio.pdf — short crosswalk that maps the network controls to our SOC 2 control IDs and where evidence lives.

Quick summary in-case you want the TL;DR here:
- Isolation model: Dedicated customers get pinned GPU pools in a VPC-per-tenant or tenant-pool arrangement with explicit egress ACLs; control plane remains in Redwood-managed VPC (separate project/tenant), accessible via peered control channels over mutual TLS.
- Private (VPC/on-prem) options: control plane can be customer-controlled (VPC endpoint + private link) or packaged as an on-prem appliance; network thermograph (page 2) shows the airgap/edge variant.
- KV/Session isolation: per-model runtime KV namespaces and cache eviction policies; tenant metadata is strictly separated and encrypted at rest.

Walkthrough — propose: Tue 25 Aug 2026, 10:00 PT (30–60 min) — let me know if that works.

Attachments: refer to filenames above (included). If you'd prefer fewer files we can redact internal doc IDs; markus and Kim are looped in to help with redaction guidance and SOC 2 mappings.

Best,
Jonas Weber
